title: First-principles insights into the structural stability, spin-polarized electronic structure, and multifunctional properties of actinide antimonides U3TSb5 [T = Cr, Mn, Ti, and V]
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27287-27299
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10072K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aman Kumar
A comprehensive first-principles study of actinide antimonides U3TSb5 [T = Cr, Mn, Ti, and V] is carried out using density functional theory to explore their structural, electronic, magnetic, mechanical, optical, phonon and thermoelectric properties.
